gen-dafont-college-gf-kufam: Kufam runs one neon-tube width all the way round, with open curves and bodies that crowd out the ascenders. College beside it adds the pair's strongest quality: a dynamic, authoritative heading over a body that stays contemporary and clean.
gen-dafont-college-gf-lexend: Oversized lowercase with open jaws makes this body text feel approachable and unfussy. Lexend holds its thickness around every curve, which gives College's dynamic, authoritative heading something steady to stand over.
gen-dafont-college-gf-lexend-deca: Approachable is the first word for this body, with an unshaded line and terminals that stop before curling back. Lexend Deca keeps its capitals small beside big lowercase, so a long page would read smoothly under College's tall, authoritative heading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-liter: Liter reads modern and upright, with no stroke contrast and wide mouths on round forms. College is best at commanding attention with thick, big-countered curves, while Liter is best at carrying tall lowercase line after line.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mada: College draws every curve as thick as its straight stems, with big counters in a tall lowercase. And where it shouts, Mada's plain sans body does the opposite, letting its open curves and towering midzone carry the quieter work.
gen-dafont-college-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads neutral and modern, with generous openings in every curve and a high mean line across each word. And a longer passage would move smoothly, since College's monoline heading leaves all the texture to this sans-serif body.
gen-dafont-college-gf-matangi: College sets every curve as thick as a straight stem. Its strongest quality is the pull between that dynamic, authoritative heading and Matangi's hefty plain sans lowercase, pressed like twine with rounded letters left open.
gen-dafont-college-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro brings a welcoming gap in the c and a high-waisted lowercase beneath College's tall counters. Maven Pro's gentle monotone line is the pair's strongest quality, softening a heading that is otherwise dynamic and authoritative.
gen-dafont-college-gf-michroma: Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, so this plain sans body reads contemporary and spaced out. And a longer passage would feel measured, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascenders sitting under College's rounded-wire heading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-miriam-libre: College leads with dynamic authority, every curve as thick as a straight stem and its lowercase tall. Miriam Libre follows in a plain sans drawn like wire, so a long read stays approachable, its s opening generously between the bends.
